newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold Resources reserves at 3.3 mln oz.
newsitem.headline: Randgold Resources reserves at 3.3 mln oz.

text.p: The African mines of Randgold Resources Ltd, to be listed on the London Stock Exchange on June 30, had attributable proven and probable reserves of 3.36 million ounces of gold at a grade of 3.83 g/t, according to an independent report released on Thursday.

The valuation, conducted by Venmyn Rand, was based on Randgold Resources' equity interest in the Syama gold mine in Mali and its two most advanced projects, Loulo in Mali and Golden Ridge in Tanzania.

"In addition, the report found that the attributable measured and indicated resources at these projects totalled 6.10 million ounces at 2.92 g/t while the attributable inferred resources at Morila in Mali, Tongon in Cote d'Iviore and Bogore in Burkina Faso amounted to 1.24 million ounces at 2.16 g/t," the report said.
Randgold said on Thursday it will up its stake in Syama to 51 percent from 20 percent.

"Continuing technical and commercial modifications are designed to enable (the) mine to profitably produce more than 250,000 ounces of gold per year from its proven open-pit orebody," Randgold said in a statement.

Loulo, is ready to be developed into an operating mine and will be capable of producing more than 140,000 ounces a year while the Golden Ridge project in Tanzania should generate 80,000 ounces a year.
